notes.title: Update news
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are having trouble replicating the issues that we have been informed of, so we ask you if you would share your thoughts on the issues!

Would you like it if the team rebuilt the game, but this time in ren'py? It will delay any updates as it is not a small undertaking, but if you ask us to then of course we will!

Leave any thoughts, requests and complaints in the comments and we will decide based on that
